svg.title: Alert Lens INC-2041
svg.desc: Pulsus Dash Alert Lens for incident INC-2041, checkout degraded: impact line (~9% purchases failing, ~€38k/h), causal sentence, impact chart with the 12:19 timeout config change, mini-Atlas with psp-api as probable origin and dashed victims, First Light onset lanes, 14 merged alerts, RCA card with HIGH 0.86 confidence, stage 1 and stage 2 progress, evidence and ruled-out items, and actions including Shift+A ack (acked by @sam), escalate and open investigation INV-2041.
